When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste any of it. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone called me?
That's not an answer. Who decided, and when?
This meeting is over. I'm leaving.
I'm staying in this chair. Sit down and tell me who entered that zero, or I walk straight upstairs to the principal's office.
Then the principal hears it from me in five minutes, along with the fact that you walked out of your own meeting. Last chance, Hale. Withdraw the zero.
Because my son got a zero on his phone in the middle of class and nobody called me. Procedure 4.2, Hale. I'm writing down that you refused to discuss it.
